newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek June inflation seen around 5.5pct - gov source.
newsitem.headline: Greek June inflation seen around 5.5pct - gov source.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will be around 5.5 percent year-on-year in June from 5.4 percent in June, a government source told Reuters.

"Inflation will be in the 5.4-5.6 percent range in July," the source said. "If it were for me to narrow the field, I would say inflation would lie between 5.5 and 5.6 percent with the 5.5 percent figure more probable."
A recent Reuters poll of 15 bankers and economists produced a mean forecast of 5.4 percent. Forecasts ranged from 5.3 percent to 5.5 percent.
The National Statistics Service is expected to release the official inflation figure for July this Friday.
